_comment: Reachable only via riverfarm_village's riverfarm_hollow_path door (round-trip pair: hollow_village_path here).

floor_layers._pick: #225 first floor layer (was flat biome-default fairy-forest green, zero floor_layers): a mottled underwood floor so the hollow no longer reads as one flat green plane. Same biome sheet (fairy_forest/Tiles.png) -- three flat underwood greens ([2,2]/[3,2]/[4,2], rgb~12,81,44) plus a darker mossy variant ([4,3], rgb~28,76,41) for texture. Footstep-earth stays honest.

entities._comment: West treeline = BACKDROP, not lid. Each canopy covers the FIVE rows above its base cell. field_y_sort_bias_px -80 (inn_roof key: sort-only, pixels unmoved) lifts the key clear, so witch_hut_door [1,7], the PC at [1,8], hollow_offering_pot [2,7] and thicket_line_den [2,2] render IN FRONT; tree stacking survives (-32 < 16 < 64). Tint is not the lever here.

A tree grown crooked, leaning in over the path like it's listening.
A tree grown crooked, leaning in over the path like it's listening.
A mossy, sagging roof, a crooked chimney, and one window that's always lit no matter the hour.
entities.toast: The door's shut. Ask her out here instead.

entities.observe: A stone taller than it should be able to stand on its own, glowing faint purple at the seams.
Another of the ring-stones, humming faintly if you hold still.
Another of the ring-stones, humming faintly if you hold still.

entities._comment: #396 GATHER beat = a GATED CONTAINER (anchor_stone_pedestal idiom): an unmet contains_when falls through to the shipped skill flavor, so the pot is byte-identical until the quest opens; container_state fills it once.
entities.skill_hint_toast: The pot waits for something cooked plain and honest.
entities.locked_toast: Something's meant to go in this, cooked properly. You don't know your way around a stew pot. Yet.

on_skill_use.toast: [Basic Cooking] — You cook the offering plain and honest, the way you'd feed anyone who'd walked far to eat.

entities.observe: An iron pot set square in the middle of the doorstep, empty, the rim wiped bright.

visual_states.observe: The pot is full to the rim now, settled a little where the wool packed down. She has not moved it off the doorstep.

entities.open_toast: You work the hollow's margin til the pot is full. Rosehips, dead-nettle, a knot of wool off the briars. Nothing rare. Everything looked at properly.

entities.item_hint_toast: The kettle wants yarrow before it gives anything back.
entities.skill_hint_toast: The cauldron is lit and the water is already moving. Stir it properly and there is a remedy in it.
entities.locked_toast: You put the spoon in and take it out again. The water goes on turning at its own pace, and nothing in the pot has changed.

on_skill_use.toast: [Hedge Remedy] — You stir like you're sorry for the sick, the way she said. What comes off the ladle runs thin and green and steadies as it cools.

entities._comment: The brew arm is INGREDIENT-GATED (requires_item + on_skill_use.remove_item, the #155 bench seam). Bounds brew->sell arbitrage by yarrow on hand; CONSUMING also arms wi_game.gd's dup-output refusal (returns BEFORE record_accomplishment), so pack-spam banks no free witch_craft_used toward [Witch]. Coverage: qa/scripts/witch_brew_loop.json.
Light budget: witch_hollow carries 1 base light (witch_cottage_prop) before this, well under the 8/map cap.
entities.skill_hint_toast: A struck match does nothing to the wicks at this door. They will only take a light you make yourself.
entities.locked_toast: A row of cold candle-stubs, set either side of the door. Bring a light that needs no striking.

on_skill_use.toast: [Light] — The candles catch, one after another, without a flame ever touching them.

entities.observe: Cold wax and old wicks, set in two rows along the threshold, each stub burned down as far as the next.

entities._comment: reuses the registered `hollow_mushroom_cluster` sprite (previously decor-only) as a distinct interactive tangle, visually apart from the standing stones themselves.
entities.skill_hint_toast: The knot is too deliberate for briar. It wants a closer look than eyes give for free.
entities.locked_toast: Roots and briar, knotted tighter than any plant ties itself. The middle of it will not hold your eye.

on_skill_use.toast: [Observe] — Look at it squarely and the knot resolves into a price, tied off and unpaid. You pay it where you stand, and the pull goes out of the briar all across the hollow.

entities.observe: Root and briar have grown into a single knot at the middle of the standing stones, the strands all pulled tight, each toward whichever stone stands closest.

entities.skill_hint_toast: The stone sits where the ground feels heaviest. That's not an accident.
entities.locked_toast: A standing stone, older than the village and not saying anything about it.

on_skill_use.toast: [Detect Magic] — Light runs under the turf in one long seam, straight through the stone and away west. The hollow is built on a current.

talk_pool: Sit. The tea is nearly right, and nothing sensible was ever decided standing up.
Kindness asks questions, dear. That is my craft, so forgive me for asking several.
The village worries loudly. I prefer to worry with a pot on.
entities.observe: A small grey witch in a hat pressed with tea leaves and old flowers. She holds a cup like the answer to a question you haven't asked yet.

lines: The fields breathe easier. So do I. Tea?
You did the hollow a kindness. It remembers, and so do I.
So you found the old hut. Somebody drew that boundary long before me, and drew it kindly.
A ward that asks is worth ten that shout. Mine ask. Sit, and I'll tell you why.

dialogue.speaker: Eloise
dialogue.text: Tea's still hot. The offer doesn't get warmer with asking twice.

entities._comment_visual_states: Visual states are order-sensitive: later satisfied entries override; dusk swaps sprite, while night also applies the legibility tint.

entities._comment: #396: ally removed -- nobody local walks you to the hollow. Solo sim gates in sim_combat_batch.gd. hunter_will_come still fields the shepherd at river_wolf_pack (village) only.
entities.observe: Briars, moving without wind. They haven't noticed you yet.
More briars, thicker here, coiled tight around something you can't quite see.
The trees thin out this way. Open fields past the last few trunks.

entities._comment: a briar-snare east of briar_collectors' nest (9,6).
entities.once_per_waking_toast: The briar holds nothing new today.
entities.skill_hint_toast: Bramble twisted into a running loop at ankle height — a snare, and the knot in it is one your hands already know.
entities.locked_toast: The brambles here twist into a tight loop, low to the ground. Pull anywhere and the whole loop moves.

on_skill_use.toast: You work the knot loose one bramble at a time, careful of the thorns. Snagged in the weave: a coin, tarnished green from the damp.

entities._comment: A separate door, so witch_cottage_prop [3,7] and witch_cottage_reachability.json stay untouched. [1,7]'s only free cardinal neighbour is [1,8]. sprite `door`, NOT witch_cottage: that art is 5x5 cells and would redraw the cottage two cells away. No `light`: the cottage prop is this map's only one. Tint = sunlit timber: hollow-green vanished against the treeline.
entities.observe: A second house at the hollow's west edge, smaller than the cottage, half its roof fallen in. The door stands open on the dark, and shallow marks cross the lintel in a line worn nearly smooth.
Bracken pressed flat in a hollow under the northern trees, and the smell of something that has been eating well.
entities.gate_closed_toast: The bracken is pressed flat and the smell of it is old. Nobody in Riverfarm has asked you to look at it.
